name: Code-like Symbols
description: Eight lines of brackets, operators and other symbols, typed as plain text. Nothing is run.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight lines of brackets, operators and symbols to type as plain text, shown on Typing Drills.
help.goal: Just practice for your fingers. The lines are text only and are never run.
howToPlay: Type the line shown, symbols included.
Correct characters are underlined and mistakes are struck through.
At the end of a line the next one appears.
tips: Symbols take a little longer. Go at your own pace.
